title: 第9章 突飞猛进第10章 灵药堂

第〇九章 突飞猛进
朝曦初露，聂空来到蓟阳城的第二个早晨，是在紫罗幻灵香“啊呀呀”的叫声中醒过来的。瑶池穴内那团墨绿血液中，芽缝又大了点的小家伙不停地颤动着，声音中明显传递出三个字：我饿了。
聂空懒洋洋地打了个呵欠，隔离出了血液中的病源，他浑身舒泰，昨晚睡得非常舒坦，要是香香不来吵他，那就更过瘾了。
“啊呀呀……”
小家伙焦急地催促起来。
自从吸收血液认主成功后，融合了药师玩家的紫罗幻灵香已不似冷冰冰的游戏数据，反倒像是有血有肉有灵性的小婴孩。
聂空只得盘膝坐好，点燃蜡烛，施展九转金针术。随着揉捻天针的速度愈来愈快，房间里顿时响起阵阵嗡鸣。
经脉中的药力，是紫罗幻灵香最好的食物。
当最先融化开来的药力汇流到“瑶池穴”时，紫罗幻灵香终于安静下来，通过芽缝大量吸收。
速度之快，让人嗔目结舌。
还不到一刻钟的功夫，昨夜剩余的八成药力，居然又去了一半，全被小家伙吸收得干干净净。
“好大的胃口。”
手上动作渐慢，聂空暗吸了口凉气，刚刚发芽就这么能吃，要是以后散叶开花了，那还了得。
心念间，聂空发现小家伙表层那道芽缝居然闭合了起来，不禁怔了一怔，连忙感应了一下，才知道紫罗幻灵香再次开始了沉眠。吃了睡，睡了吃，真是……猪啊！聂空忍不住摇了摇头。
小家伙不再需要药力，聂空却没有停手，继续进行“九转金针术”的第二个循环。这一次，聂空的对象是那些凝结在经脉中的灵力，而他选择的第一条经脉，便是奇经八脉中的任脉。
任脉不但串通着修炼灵力的根基“灵神三窍”，也连接着瑶池、迷泉、天宫三大隐穴，自然是疏通经脉时的首选。
聂空默运“五星挪移诀”，丹田内三大窍穴开始震动。在聂空的操控下，灵力凝聚于右手拇指和食指，通过不断的揉捻，注入那枚天阵之中。这第二循环，聂空动用了自身所有的力量。
霎时间，犹如平静的湖面投入了块巨石，金针激烈震荡，在那此起彼伏的嗡鸣声中，聂空体内经脉如波纹般荡漾起来。全身更是如同架在了熔炉上面，肌肤通红如血，热浪透出毛孔。
蓦地，**穴处冒出一股暖流，却是凝如实质的灵力开始溶解。就像是倒下的多米诺骨牌，灵力的溶解在**处出现后，便一发不可收拾，缕缕翠绿的气息散化开来，那全部都是木系灵力。
感受着流水般注入到“灵神三窍”的灵力，聂空才意识到这身体原主人苦修十年积攒下来的灵力是何等精纯，何等强大。他的努力并没有白费，不过享受他苦修成果的已换成了现在的聂空。

融化在持续，灵力不断攀升。
眨眼间，“灵神三窍”就被撑得似要爆炸开来。隐隐间，聂空仿佛在窍穴中感觉到了一堵无形的壁障。
“快要突破了？”聂空心中微喜，更多的灵力注入天针，手上速度骤然加快，任脉内灵力疾速消融，如丝如缕地涌入窍穴，而后随着窍穴的剧烈的震动，如惊涛骇浪般朝那层无形壁障冲击了过去。
“轰！”
体内一声爆鸣，聂空身躯一震，接着整个人便似飘了起来，一种顺畅自如的舒爽感觉涌遍全身。
聚灵二品！
这个提升的过程竟是轻松自如，那点阻碍几乎可以忽略不计。境界的跃进，实力的增长，带来的是自信的提升，以及那种美妙的快感，尤其是突破的刹那，就像是吸毒一样，飘飘欲仙。
现在，聂空总算有些理解前世那些吸毒者为什么屡戒不成了。暗暗感叹一声，聂空压下心中的欢喜，继续融化灵力。
经神阙，过巨阙，灵力很快溶解到了紫宫穴。
聂空再次触摸到了那层壁障。有了上次的经验，这回聂空没有任何的犹豫，大量精纯的灵力积聚在灵神三窍。他没有贸然去冲击壁障，而是极力压制着蠢蠢欲动的灵力，将它们束缚在窍穴中。
当任脉疏通到璇玑穴时，聂空的压制已濒临崩溃的边缘。意念一动，灵力就如同冲出牢笼的洪荒凶兽，张牙舞爪地向那壁障扑了过去。之前的束缚，让此刻的冲击展现出了更强的爆发力。
“呼！呼！”
如惊涛拍岸，浪潮一波接着一波，窍穴内竟卷起了三个漩涡。
冲击壁障所带来的强烈劲道撕扯着聂空的身躯，他那瘦弱的身子爆出喀喀声响，全身骨头便似散架了一般，疼痛难当，可在这样的紧要关头，聂空揉捻天针的右手却不敢有丝毫的松懈。
“轰！”
数分钟后，聂空终于迎来了那种期待已久的感觉，窍穴豁然贯通，灵力奔腾流转，盈盈如水。
聚灵三品！
恰好这时，灵力消解到了承浆穴，整条任脉完全畅达。
聂空放慢捻针的速度，默默运转五星挪移诀，调动灵力，调理身体，过了半晌，将金针一一取出。
抹抹额头的汗水，聂空长舒口气，不到半个小时，便用一条任脉的灵力接连突破到聚灵三品，的确值得高兴，可刚才突破时的情形，也让聂空意识到了自己最大的弱点，那就是身弱体虚。

在突破到聚灵三品时，这具身体竟差点崩溃，更遑论其它。
聂空忖道：“当务之急，还是得好好调理身体。只可惜时间不够呀，前天武童他们没能得逞，以聂风行的性子，肯定不会善罢甘休，得尽快想办法弄到一瓶‘回春露’，绝了聂风行的借口。”
一瓶回春露，最少都要一万金币，而且还不一定能在蓟阳城买得到。聂空有点头疼起来，将突破到聚灵三品的喜悦冲淡了不少。
“咚咚！”敲门声响起。
“进来！”
聂空随口道。
房门轻轻推开，花眉的面庞显露出来。看到床上**上身的聂空，花眉就像受惊的小鹿，“哎呀”一声，娇躯一缩，砰的将房门关起。聂空一愣，这才醒悟过来，忙抓过衣服往身上套去。
好一会儿，门外才传来花眉细细的声音：“叔叔，出来洗漱吃饭了。”
出去后，花眉正在厅中摆放碗筷，脸蛋还是红扑扑的，见到聂空的身影，眼神有点躲躲闪闪。
聂空有点好笑，这要是换了前世的女孩子，别说只看到男人暴露的上身，就算把全身都看光了，她或许还会鄙夷地撇撇嘴，说上一声“切，不就是三条腿么，老娘看得多了”，不过这也正好彰显了花眉的清纯。

Chapter 09: Rapid Progress
When the morning light first appeared, Nie Kong woke up to the sound of "Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhh" of the purple phantom spirit fragrance on the second morning after he came to Jiyang City. In the dark green blood in the Yaochi point, the little guy with a slightly larger bud was trembling constantly, and three words were clearly conveyed in his voice: I am hungry.
Nie Kong yawned lazily and isolated the source of the disease in his blood. He felt comfortable all over. He slept very comfortably last night. It would have been even more enjoyable if Xiangxiang didn't disturb him.
"Ahhhh..."
The little guy urged anxiously.
Since successfully absorbing blood and identifying its master, the purple phantom scent that has been fused with the medicine man player no longer looks like cold game data, but rather like a baby with flesh and blood and spirituality.
Nie Kong had no choice but to sit cross-legged, light candles, and perform the Nine-turn Golden Needle Technique. As the speed of twisting the needle became faster and faster, there was a buzzing sound in the room.
The medicinal power in the meridians is the best food for Ziluo Phantom Spirit Incense.
When the first melted medicinal power flowed into the "Yaochi Point", the Purple Phantom Fragrance finally calmed down and was absorbed in large quantities through the bud gaps.
The speed is so fast that it is jaw-dropping.
In less than a quarter of an hour, half of the remaining 80% of last night's potion was completely absorbed by the little guy.
"What a huge appetite."
The movement of his hands gradually slowed down, and Nie Kong secretly took a breath of cool air. It was so edible just after it sprouted. If the loose leaves bloom in the future, it would be great.
While thinking about it, Nie Kong found that the bud gap on the surface of the little guy had actually closed. He couldn't help but be startled. He quickly sensed it and realized that the purple phantom fragrance had begun to sleep again. Eat and sleep, sleep and eat, what a... pig! Nie Kong couldn't help but shook his head.
The little guy no longer needed the power of the medicine, but Nie Kong did not stop and continued the second cycle of the "Nine-turn Golden Needle Technique". This time, Nie Kong's target was the spiritual power condensed in the meridians, and the first meridian he chose was the Ren meridian among the eight extraordinary meridians.
The Ren meridian is not only connected to the "Three Spiritual Apertures" which are the foundation of spiritual power cultivation, but also connected to the three hidden acupoints of Yaochi, Miquan and Tiangong. It is naturally the first choice when dredging the meridians.
Nie Kongmo used the "Five Star Movement Technique", and the three major acupoints in the Dantian began to vibrate. Under Nie Kong's control, the spiritual power was concentrated on the thumb and index finger of his right hand, and was injected into the heavenly formation through constant rubbing. In this second cycle, Nie Kong used all his power.
In an instant, as if a huge stone was thrown into the calm lake, the golden needle vibrated violently. Amidst the buzzing sounds, the meridians in Nie Kong's body rippled like ripples. The whole body felt as if it were placed on top of a furnace, the skin was as red as blood, and heat waves penetrated the pores.
Suddenly, a warm current emerged from the vaginal acupuncture point, but the spiritual power that was as solid as substance began to dissolve. Like a falling domino, the dissolution of spiritual power was out of control after it appeared in the vagina, and wisps of emerald green breath dispersed, all of which were wood spiritual power.
Feeling the spiritual power poured into the "Three Spiritual Apertures" like flowing water, Nie Kong realized how pure and powerful the spiritual power accumulated by the original owner of the body for ten years was. His efforts were not in vain, but it was now Nie Kong who enjoyed the fruits of his hard work.
The melting continues, and the spiritual power continues to rise.
In the blink of an eye, the "Three Spiritual Apertures" were so stretched that they seemed to explode. Faintly, Nie Kong seemed to feel an invisible barrier in his acupoints.
"About to break through?" Nie Kong felt slightly happy as he injected more spiritual power into the Heavenly Needle. His hand speed suddenly increased. The spiritual power in his Ren Veins melted rapidly and poured into the acupoints like threads. Then, with the violent vibration of the acupoints, he rushed towards the invisible barrier like a turbulent wave.
"Boom!"
There was an explosion in his body, and Nie Kong's body trembled, and then his whole body seemed to be floating, and a smooth and comfortable feeling surged throughout his body.
The second grade of Gathering Spirits!
This process of improvement is actually easy and natural.For example, that obstacle is almost negligible. The leap forward in realm and the growth in strength bring about an increase in self-confidence and that wonderful pleasure, especially the moment of breakthrough, which is like taking drugs and feeling ecstasy.
Now, Nie Kong finally understood why those drug addicts in his previous life failed to quit. Sighing secretly, Nie Kong suppressed the joy in his heart and continued to melt his spiritual power.
After passing through Shenque and Juque, the spiritual power quickly dissolved into the Zigong point.
Nie Kong touched the barrier again. With the experience last time, Nie Kong did not hesitate this time, and a large amount of pure spiritual power accumulated in the three spiritual orifices. He did not rush to attack the barrier, but tried his best to suppress the spiritual power that was about to move, and bound them in the apertures.
When the Ren channel was unblocked to the Xuanji point, Nie Kong's suppression was on the verge of collapse. With a thought, the spiritual power was like a wild beast that broke out of the cage and rushed towards the barrier with its fangs and claws. The previous restraint made the impact at this moment more explosive.
"Hoo! Hoo!"
Like a stormy sea crashing on the shore, one wave after another, and three whirlpools rolled up in the orifice.
The strong force brought by the impact on the barrier tore Nie Kong's body. His thin body made a rattling sound, and the bones in his body seemed to fall apart. The pain was unbearable, but at this critical moment, Nie Kong did not dare to relax at all with his right hand that was twisting the Heavenly Needle.
"Boom!"
A few minutes later, Nie Kong finally experienced the long-awaited feeling. His acupoints were suddenly opened, and his spiritual energy was flowing like water.
The third level of Gathering Spirits!
Just at this time, the spiritual power was dissipated to the Chengjian point, and the entire Ren channel was completely unobstructed.
Nie Kong slowed down the speed of twisting the needles, silently running the five-star movement technique, mobilizing his spiritual power, regulating his body, and after a long while, he took out the golden needles one by one.
Wiping the sweat from his forehead, Nie Kong breathed a sigh of relief. In less than half an hour, he used the spiritual power of Ren channel to break through to the third level of Juling. It was indeed worthy of joy. However, the situation when he broke through just now also made Nie Kong aware of his biggest weakness, which was his physical weakness.
When he broke through to the third level of gathering spirit, this body almost collapsed, let alone other things.
Nie Kong thought: "The top priority is to take good care of the body. It's a pity that there is not enough time. Wu Tong and the others failed to succeed the day before yesterday. With Nie Fengxing's temperament, he will definitely not give up. He must find a way to get a bottle of 'Rejuvenation Dew' as soon as possible to eliminate Nie Fengxing's excuses."
A bottle of rejuvenating dew costs at least 10,000 gold coins, and it may not be available in Jiyang City. Nie Kong felt a little headache, which diluted the joy of breaking through to the third level of gathering spirit.
"Dong dong!" There was a knock on the door.
"Come in!"
Nie Kong said casually.
The door opened slightly, and Huamei's face was revealed. Seeing the topless Nie Kong on the bed, Hua Mei was like a frightened deer. She said "Oh!", shrunk her delicate body, and slammed the door. Nie Kong was stunned for a moment, then he came to his senses and hurriedly grabbed his clothes and put them on.
After a while, there was a thin voice from outside the door: "Uncle, come out to wash up and eat."
After going out, Huamei was placing dishes and chopsticks in the hall, her face was still red, and when she saw Nie Kong's figure, her eyes were a little evasive.
Nie Kong was a little funny. If it were a girl in her previous life, not to mention only seeing the man's exposed upper body, even if she saw the whole body, she might have curled her lips in disdain and said, "Oh, it's just three legs. I've seen too much." However, this just shows the innocence of Huamei.
